free_tier.stated: 'Storage: No minimum, 50GB maximum' per app — but the filesystem is the build container, not durable storage.

retention.stated: until the instance is recycled; not persistent

egress.terms: Free; apps are public by default with no transfer meter.

tooling: Apps deploy from a GitHub repo; the app process is an HTTP server, so anything it can read it can serve. No storage API.
chaining: None. The 50 GB is a ceiling on what the container can hold, not an allocation you can write to and keep.
limits_note: 690 MB min / 2.7 GB max RAM; 50 GB max storage; app code must come from GitHub; apps sleep when unused; 'these limits may change at any time without notice'.
reliability_note: Ephemeral build filesystem — any file written at runtime is lost on reboot/redeploy. Useful only as a free public egress proxy in front of someone else's storage.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
